coverage.statement: CareerPath combines UK-wide Find a Tender coverage with complementary lower-value and specialist sources. Known coverage limitations are published rather than hidden.

methodology.accessBoundary: The public feed exposes headline published opportunity facts only. Full requirements, evaluation, commercial analysis, contract history, change intelligence, local delivery, provider relevance, supply-chain comparison and mobilisation/workforce intelligence are premium.
methodology.sourceCoverage: CareerPath publishes source coverage and known gaps explicitly. A missing record is never treated as proof that no opportunity exists.
methodology.noPrediction: CareerPath does not publish win probability or undisclosed bid recommendations.
